title: Erdos-Szemeredi Sum-Product Conjecture for Integers
exact_target: Must a finite integer set expand almost quadratically under either addition or multiplication?

sources.citation: Noga Alon, Omer Angel, Itai Benjamini, and Eyal Lubetzky, Sums and products along sparse graphs, Israel Journal of Mathematics 188 (2012), 353-384.
